list_scaling_groups.title: List scaling groups
list_scaling_groups.description: List scaling groups in a region with their size bounds, current capacity, state and active configuration. Start here to find a scaling_group_id.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

scaling_group_id.description: Return only this group.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The scaling groups and the total count.

create_scaling_group.title: Create a scaling group
create_scaling_group.description: Create a scaling group in a VPC. It is Inactive until enable_scaling_group is called with a scaling configuration.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

removal_policy.description: Which instances go first on scale-in.

load_balancer_ids.description: A JSON array string of CLB instance IDs to register instances with.

update_scaling_group.title: Update a scaling group
update_scaling_group.description: Change a group's size bounds, desired capacity, name, cooldown or active configuration. Raising min_size or desired_capacity launches instances.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

enable_scaling_group.title: Enable a scaling group
enable_scaling_group.description: Enable a scaling group so it launches instances to reach min_size and runs its rules and tasks.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

active_scaling_configuration_id.description: The configuration to use; required the first time.

disable_scaling_group.title: Disable a scaling group
disable_scaling_group.description: Disable a scaling group: running instances stay, but no scaling activity, rule or scheduled task runs until it is enabled again.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

delete_scaling_group.title: Delete a scaling group
delete_scaling_group.description: Delete a scaling group. With force_delete it also removes and releases the instances it created; otherwise it fails while instances are in it.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

force_delete.description: Remove and release the group's instances too.

scale_with_adjustment.title: Scale now
scale_with_adjustment.description: Change a group's capacity right away, by a count, a percentage, or to an exact total.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

adjustment_value.description: The change or target; negative values scale in.

list_scaling_configurations.title: List scaling configurations
list_scaling_configurations.description: List the launch templates a group uses for new instances: image, instance type, security group, disks and key pair.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

scaling_group_id.description: Return only this group's configurations.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

create_scaling_configuration.title: Create a scaling configuration
create_scaling_configuration.description: Create a configuration describing the ECS instances a group launches.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

internet_max_bandwidth_out.description: Public bandwidth in Mbit/s; 0 for no public IP.

key_pair_name.description: An SSH key pair for Linux instances.

user_data.description: Base64 user data run at first boot.

ram_role_name.description: A RAM role to attach to the instances.

delete_scaling_configuration.title: Delete a scaling configuration
delete_scaling_configuration.description: Delete a configuration that is not the group's active one.

list_scaling_instances.title: List instances in a group
list_scaling_instances.description: List a group's instances with how each joined (auto-created or attached), its lifecycle state and health.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

creation_type.description: Filter by how the instance joined.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

output.description: The instances and the total count.

attach_instance.title: Attach an instance
attach_instance.description: Add an existing ECS instance to a group. It must be in the group's VPC and the group must stay under max_size.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

instance_id.description: The ECS instance ID. Call once per instance.

entrusted.description: Let the group manage the instance's lifecycle and release it on scale-in.

remove_instance.title: Remove an instance
remove_instance.description: Remove an instance from a group. Auto-created instances are released; attached ones are only detached unless the policy says otherwise.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

instance_id.description: The ECS instance ID. Call once per instance.

decrease_desired_capacity.description: Lower desired capacity so no replacement is launched.

enter_standby.title: Put an instance on standby
enter_standby.description: Put an instance on standby: it stays running but is taken out of load balancing and health checks, for maintenance.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

instance_id.description: The ECS instance ID. Call once per instance.

exit_standby.title: Return an instance from standby
exit_standby.description: Return a standby instance to service and load balancing.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

instance_id.description: The ECS instance ID. Call once per instance.

set_instance_protection.title: Protect an instance from scale-in
set_instance_protection.description: Turn scale-in protection on or off for an instance in a group.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

instance_id.description: The ECS instance ID. Call once per instance.

list_scaling_rules.title: List scaling rules
list_scaling_rules.description: List a group's scaling rules: simple, step, target tracking and predictive.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

scaling_group_id.description: Return only this group's rules.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

create_scaling_rule.title: Create a scaling rule
create_scaling_rule.description: Create a simple scaling rule that changes capacity when executed by an alarm, a scheduled task or execute_scaling_rule.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

adjustment_value.description: The change or target; negative values scale in.

cooldown.description: Seconds before the rule may run again.

execute_scaling_rule.title: Execute a scaling rule
execute_scaling_rule.description: Run a simple scaling rule now, outside its alarm or schedule.

delete_scaling_rule.title: Delete a scaling rule
delete_scaling_rule.description: Delete a scaling rule. Alarms and scheduled tasks that call it stop having an effect.

list_scheduled_tasks.title: List scheduled tasks
list_scheduled_tasks.description: List scheduled tasks that change a group's capacity at set times.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

scaling_group_id.description: Return only this group's tasks.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

create_scheduled_task.title: Create a scheduled task
create_scheduled_task.description: Schedule a capacity change, once or recurring. Set desired_capacity (or min_value/max_value) and the group to act on.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

scaling_group_id.description: The group to change.

launch_time.description: When it first runs, UTC, YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ.

recurrence_value.description: The repeat detail, e.g. 1 for daily, 0,6 for weekends, or a cron expression.

delete_scheduled_task.title: Delete a scheduled task
delete_scheduled_task.description: Delete a scheduled task so it no longer runs.

list_scaling_activities.title: List scaling activities
list_scaling_activities.description: List a group's scaling activities, with their cause, instances added or removed, status and any error.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_alarms.title: List event-triggered tasks
list_alarms.description: List the CloudMonitor alarm tasks that run scaling rules on metric thresholds.

region_id.description: The region ID of the resources, e.g. cn-hangzhou or ap-southeast-1.

scaling_group_id.description: Return only this group's alarms.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

list_lifecycle_hooks.title: List lifecycle hooks
list_lifecycle_hooks.description: List lifecycle hooks, which pause instances on launch or termination so custom actions can run.

scaling_group_id.description: The scaling group ID, e.g. asg-bp18p2yfxow2dloq****.

page_number.description: The page to return, starting at 1.

get_limits.title: Get account limits
get_limits.description: Read the account's Auto Scaling quotas, such as groups per region and instances per group.

list_regions.title: List regions
list_regions.description: List the regions Auto Scaling is available in, with their endpoints.
